text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Iraqi official press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Iraq urges U.N. secretary-general to approve food distribution plan under oil-for-food deal with U.N.
- Iraq to distribute full food rations to Iraqis in August.
- Oil Ministry organises symposium on improving environment.
- Two ships loaded with food bought under oil-for-food deal anchor at Umm Qasr.
(The above were also carried by IRAQ and JUMHOURIYA)
